--- create_sequence_params_options.sql
CREATE SEQUENCE MySequence BIT_REVERSED_POSITIVE START COUNTER WITH 50 OPTIONS (
    skip_range_min = 1,
    skip_range_max = 1000)
--- AST
&ast.CreateSequence{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 16,
        NameEnd: 26,
        Name:    "MySequence",
      },
    },
  },
  Params: []ast.SequenceParam{
    &ast.BitReversedPositive{
      BitReversedPositive: 27,
    },
    &ast.StartCounterWith{
      Start:   49,
      Counter: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 68,
        ValueEnd: 70,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "50",
      },
    },
  },
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 71,
    Rparen:  130,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 85,
          NameEnd: 99,
          Name:    "skip_range_min",
        },
        Value: &ast.IntLiteral{
          ValuePos: 102,
          ValueEnd: 103,
          Base:     10,
          Value:    "1",
        },
      },
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 109,
          NameEnd: 123,
          Name:    "skip_range_max",
        },
        Value: &ast.IntLiteral{
          ValuePos: 126,
          ValueEnd: 130,
          Base:     10,
          Value:    "1000",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEQUENCE MySequence BIT_REVERSED_POSITIVE START COUNTER WITH 50 OPTIONS (skip_range_min = 1, skip_range_max = 1000)
